subject: Pre-demo intake: batch profile & rollout windows
messages:
From: Sam Torres <sam.torres@marketly.ai>
To: irene_choi@redwood.ai
Cc: Asha Reddy <asha@marketly.ai>
Date: 2027-10-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Interested in Redwood Inference Pilot

Hi Irene,

I signed up for a trial over the weekend and liked what I saw in the docs — would love to run a short pilot to validate latency and cost for a reranking use case. Quick context:

- Company: Marketly (ecommerce search + recommendations)
- Use case: reranking paid-search results with contextual rerank signals (title / query / user embeddings)
- Expected volume: ~2M tokens/day initially, spiking to ~6M on promo days
- Concurrency: typical 20-30 qps, peak ~80 qps for 10-15m bursts
- Latency target: 80-120ms p95 for rerank call (we can tolerate a small async fallback)
- Timeline: want pilot in the next 4–8 weeks; budgeted for a 6-week evaluation

I've attached a small traffic CSV (traffic snapshot) and a short product note.

Can we schedule a 30-minute call/demo to walk through how Redwood would handle our prefix caching / batching and what Dedicated vs hosted looks like for this workload? Timezone: Pacific (PST).

Thanks — Sam

--
Sam Torres
Head of Search & Recommendations
Marketly
Attachments: marketly-traffic-snapshot.csv (CSV, 3KB), pilot-outline.pdf (PDF, 120KB)
From: irene_choi@redwood.ai <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Torres <sam.torres@marketly.ai>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-10-05T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interested in Redwood Inference Pilot

Hi Sam — great to meet you and thanks for the snapshot. I'm on the SDR team and will coordinate the intake + demo. A few quick clarifying questions so we make the demo productive:

1) Example payload: are the requests single-document rerank calls (short prompt + candidate list) or multi-document concatenation? Rough token per request estimate helps us size KV cache.
2) Are you planning to run the pilot on Hosted (Redwood API) or do you need a Dedicated pool / private VPC for data isolation?
3) Any compliance constraints we should prep for (SOC2, HIPAA, custom logging retention)?
4) Which afternoon windows (PST) next week work for you? I can do 10/11–10/15 afternoons between 1–4pm PST.

Proposed agenda for the 30-minute session:
- 5m: quick intro + goals for the pilot
- 10m: traffic profile and batching/KV caching Q&A (we'll look at the CSV together)
- 10m: demo of routing, batching, and an example rollout plan (canary -> full)
- 5m: next steps (pilot scope, success metrics, DocuSign if needed)

Ben (AE) and Priyom (Solutions) are cc'd — we'll bring a quick pilot outline and a cost estimate once we confirm the slot.

If you prefer, send two good times and we'll lock one.

Best,
Irene
SDR, Redwood Inference

Thanks, Irene — answers below inline. Sorry for the long reply.

1) Payload: we send a small prompt (40–80 tokens) + candidate list of ~10 titles (each ~8–12 tokens). So ~200 tokens per request on average.
2) Pilot: initially hosted to move faster; if performance is solid we will talk dedicated capacity after the pilot.
3) Compliance: SOC 2 is required; we do not need HIPAA. We will need basic audit logs and the ability to limit data retention during the pilot.
4) Times: next week afternoons look good for our team — prefer 10/12 or 10/14 between 1–3pm PST.

Other items:
- We have an internal SRE who may join for a short part to ask about network egress and peering.
- We'd like a brief section on cost sensitivity during the demo (how batching + quantization impacts price).

I'll attach a short internal note that clarifies our endpoint shapes.

Sam

--
Sam Torres
Head of Search & Recommendations
Marketly

- Option A: Tue 2027-10-12 13:00–13:30 PT
- Option B: Thu 2027-10-14 14:00–14:30 PT
- Option C: Thu 2027-10-14 15:00–15:30 PT

If Option A works we'll mark it as tentative and send a calendar invite. Agenda will follow Irene's outline; Priyom will demo batching and show how prefix/KV caching would impact your 200-token requests and burst behavior. We'll also show a cost comparison table (hosted vs small dedicated pool).

Pre-demo checklist (short):
- Confirm attendee list (include SRE if possible)
- Share any blocked IP ranges or firewall info if you need to test direct egress flows
- Let us know if you want a short SOC 2 packet ahead of time (we can attach it)

Sam — which option do you prefer?

Cheers,
